steps: 1. Open General with a previously completed check. Record current time and last-check text; click Check for updates once and capture the activity status before, during and after callback completion.

2. Correlate the UI with the runner check callback/result and stored last-check time. Repeat a successful up-to-date check; compare an update-available fixture and a controlled network-failure case without installing the update.
3. Confirm whether the repeated Check for updates action is intentionally available and whether it actually invokes another check; do not infer cache suppression from the button text.

4. Capture the outline opening/closing and stationary states in Light/Dark/High Contrast at100/125/150percent scaling, then compare animation/transparency settings. Identify which boundary is obscured before changing acrylic/border/shadow layout.
5. Coordinate update-feedback overlap with43004/16010 while keeping the separate outline result explicit; add focused state/visual regression checks only for confirmed failures.

proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: the activity card can expose previous last-check information while a quick manual check completes, making the retained repeat-check action misleading. The separate outline symptom may involve acrylic background/border/shadow composition; neither mechanism is confirmed by still screenshots.

plan: Reproduce the supplied General-page sequence and correlate Checking/completion state, last-check text and callback timestamps before deciding whether feedback is delayed or merely ambiguous.

If a stale completion-state binding or misleading feedback is confirmed, make a localized UpdateViewModel/UpdateStatusControl correction with existing localized strings and commands; preserve the ability to run another genuine manual check.

For the outline, isolate background sizing, border/shadow and animation behavior in UpdateActivityControl under theme/scaling controls before choosing a minimal correction. Do not globally remove acrylic/shadows or change drivers/network policy without evidence.

confidence.rationale: The manual callback and source paths are evidenced, but stale-completion versus short-lived previous-state display and the moving outline still require controlled runtime isolation. This is not an implementation-ready design.
